data.name: Gearard
data.gender_notes: Gearard is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Latin Gerardus, derived from gera, 'spear', and hart, 'brave' or 'strong'. The name Gearard was popular among the Normans, meaning 'brave spearman'. The name Gearard carries the meaning “Spear-brave” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Gearard usually hope their child will grow to embody spear-brave and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes bravery and strength in the face of adversity.
data.etymology: Gearard belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Spear-brave.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gearard total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_hebrew.name: גיררד
in_hebrew.long_meaning: גיררד הוא שם פרטי שמקורו בשפה הגרמנית ומשמעותו 'חזק, נועז, איש חזק'. השם מורכב מרכיבים גרמניים עתיקים 'ger' שפירושו 'חץ' או 'רומח' ו'hard' שפירושו 'חזק' או 'נועז'. השם היה נפוץ בקרב אצילים וגיבורים גרמניים בתקופה המרובינגית והקארולינגית.

in_greek.name: Γκεράρ
in_greek.long_meaning: Γκεράρ είναι ένα όνομα που προέρχεται από τη γερμανική γλώσσα και σημαίνει 'ισχυρός, τολμηρός, γενναίος'. Το όνομα αποτελείται από τα γερμανικά στοιχεία 'ger' που σημαίνει 'βέλος' ή 'δόρυ' και 'hard' που σημαίνει 'ισχυρός' ή 'γενναίος'. Το όνομα ήταν δημοφιλές ανάμεσα σε ευγενείς και ήρωες στη γερμανική εποχή των Μεροβίγγιων και Καρολιγγίων.

in_latin.name: Gearard
in_latin.long_meaning: Gearard est nomen proprium quod origine sua in lingua germanica habet et significat 'fortis, audax, vir fortis'. Nomen componitur ex elementis germanicis antiquioribus 'ger' quod significat 'sagitta' aut 'hasta' et 'hard' quod significat 'fortis' aut 'audax'. Nomen apud nobiles et heroes germanicos in aetate merovingica et carolingica usitatum erat.

in_english.name: Gearard
in_english.long_meaning: Gearard is a Christian name derived from Germanic roots, meaning 'strong, brave, spear ruler'. It originates from the Old High German words 'ger' meaning 'spear' and 'hard' meaning 'brave' or 'strong'. Historically, the name was popular among nobles and heroes in the Merovingian and Carolingian periods. It symbolizes strength, courage, and leadership, reflecting the virtues valued in Christian tradition.

data.cultural_impact: Gearard carries a rich Anglo-Saxon and Norman heritage, signifying bravery, strength, and honor in battle.
data.spiritual_significance: Gearard can be seen as a symbol of divine protection and courage. The name invokes visuals of a warrior, armed with a spear and shield, standing firm against adversity, reminding us to be similarly steadfast in our faith and trust in God to guide us through life's challenges. Additionally, the meaning of 'spear' may represent the concept of being as sharp and focused as a spearpoint in our communication with and service to God.
